protocol.change: No change to the pilot's main-pair learner, target rule, prompts, rollout budgets, optimizer, normalization, or checkpoints. Fresh practice/evaluation cohorts and three new optimization seeds. Raw one-rollout control is not repeated.
protocol.primary: Final current-minus-frozen reasoning accuracy across three paired optimization seeds and 144 new questions. No interim scoring or hyperparameter changes. No exponent fitting.
protocol.resources: Three institutional H100 workers on gpu_lowp. Save and SHA-256 archive final seed71000 models only. No paid APIs or Vast.

bootstrap: 5000 paired resamples of three optimization seeds and 144 questions, stratified by program depth. Three seeds and one shared fresh cohort limit uncertainty estimates. Intervals are pointwise; perfect scores can give degenerate bootstrap intervals.
scope: Fresh-data confirmation of the unchanged two-arm full-trace recipe, same architecture. Neither an independent-model replication nor an exponent estimate.
